systems.system: e-Delivery (National Development Plans and Projects Management System)
systems.tiers: all ministries, independent departments, government agencies, regional administrations and local government authorities will be required to use it from 1 July 2026

note: A directive only: the NPC said on or before 18 June 2026 that local government authorities will be required to register and report all development projects in e-Delivery from 1 July 2026; the document does not say any council is yet working in it, nor how council offices are connected.
